WHAT IT CARRIES: U-117, the checker propagates capabilities SCC-exactly and iteratively so cycle order cannot hide a requirement. D-107 and D-107b, garnet check rejects in safe functions a unit variant given a payload, a payload variant used bare, a payload arity mismatch and an unknown variant, through module-qualified and aliased paths, and an impl on one enum exempts only that enum. D-02, the time class (time::now_ms and the clock-seeded uuid) is gated by @caps(time) at run time on the interpreter and the VM, not only at check time. D-04 and D-04b, memory is its own capability kind mem (ADR 0011): the four memory::* constructors gain registry rows (84 rows, 82 bound natives, gated surface 24) and, with first-class memory declarations, require @caps(mem) in the calling chain on both backends and in the WASM adapter; fs does not grant it. The playground gains an Undeclared memory tier preset, the W-PLAY package and browser proof are re-recorded, and docs/truth.json and docs/status.html are re-stamped: readiness 93.1 to 93.0 because the committed Windows and WSL domain-matrix bundles pin the SHA-256 of examples/multi_agent_builder.garnet and examples/agentic_log_analyzer.garnet, which D-04b changed from @caps() to @caps(mem); the bundles are left as written and lane 19 stays source-present until re-run on those hosts.
